question: R Muthukannammal was conferred the Padma Shri award in 2022. Which of the following is her contribution ?

options.text: Working with Orissa’s poor and backward communities
Specializing in the study of Indian society
Being a custodian of the early dance form of Bharatnatyam
Playing a key role in powering India’s Blue Revolution

solution:
The correct answer is __**Being a custodian of the early dance form of Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• R Muthukannammal is recognized as a **living custodian of the early dance form of Bharatnatyam**.
 
• She has preserved the **traditional dance form of Bharatnatyam** through her dedication and passion.
 
• Her contribution has been acknowledged by conferring her the **Padma Shri award in 2022**.
 
• She has played a crucial role in **keeping the heritage of Bharatnatyam alive** for future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatnatyam**

 
 
• Bharatnatyam is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork, along with a sophisticated vocabulary of hand and facial gestures.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed by women.
 
• The dance is usually accompanied by classical Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri Award**
 
 
• It is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded by the Government of India, every year on India's Republic Day.
 
• The award recognizes individuals for their distinguished contribution in various spheres such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Shri award are announced annually on Republic Day and are conferred by the President of India at a ceremonial function at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
